title: How Writing a Prayer by Hand Slows a Restless Man Down
caption:
Your mind runs faster than your prayers. A pen doesn't.

Writing it out forces one honest sentence at a time, and that is where a restless man finally stops performing and starts talking to God.

Save this and try it tonight with five minutes and a cheap notebook.

#faith #prayer #godlyman #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
